description: License policy for every package in the sidecar dependency tree. Checked by scripts/check-npm-licenses.mjs as part of `just deny`.

notes.MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-*, 0BSD, ISC, MPL-2: Allowlist from docs/02-plan.md M0. MPL-2.0 covers camoufox-js.
notes.BlueOak-1.0.0: Permissive. glob, minimatch, lru-cache and friends, reached from camoufox-js.
notes.CC0-1.0: Public-domain dedication. language-subtag-registry (data), reached from camoufox-js.
notes.CC-BY-4.0: Attribution license on data only. caniuse-lite, reached from fingerprint-generator.
notes.exceptions: None. ua-parser-js 2.x (AGPL-3.0-or-later, asked for by camoufox-js) is replaced by the MIT 1.0.x line through a pnpm override; see ADR 0008.
